problems.question: contradicts_spec
problems.issue: The length comparison uses `s.len() as f64`, and the early-return branch is spec-correct only in intent. The non-early path returns the wrong value (see made_up_results). StringPad step 2-3 (empty fillString returns string) and steps 4-7 (fillLength, truncated filler, start/end placement) are entirely absent, so the result contradicts the spec for all inputs that need padding.
